result.title: GaokaoMathGen: Chinese Gaokao Mathematics Finale Problem Generation Controlled by Latent Reasoning Structures
result.comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 16 tables, including the technical supplement
result.summary: Generating Chinese Gaokao mathematics finale problems requires controlling not only the included skills, but also the underlying mathematical kernel and solution path. Existing LLM-based methods mainly rely on surface-level specifications, while the realized difficulty of generated problems cannot be determined directly from prompted targets. Therefore, we propose GaokaoMathGen, a framework for Chinese Gaokao mathematics finale problem generation controlled by latent reasoning structures. It extracts standardized latent reasoning structures from seed problems and performs constrained synthesis using skills, methods, a core identity, and a pivot step as structural controls. We further estimate realized difficulty through logical-quality filtering, fixed-solver decoding effort, structural features, and solver-output search signals. Experiments show that semantic normalization improves cross-annotator comparability and that 78.0% of 609 scored candidates pass the logical-quality filter. In a teacher audit of the 60 highest-effort candidates, all were judged to reach finale or penultimate problem difficulty, and only one exhibited a severe logical issue. These results support latent reasoning structures as effective control signals for generating high-difficulty mathematical problems.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 GaokaoMathGen，从种子题中抽取标准化的「潜在推理结构」（技能、方法、核心恒等式、关键步骤），并以此作为结构控制生成高考数学压轴题，同时用逻辑质量过滤、固定 solver 解码开销与结构特征估计实际难度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「潜在推理结构」只是数据侧的推理骨架标注而非模型内部状态，但「用解题轨迹骨架约束生成」与「以 solver 解码开销度量难度」可能为 LVR 的轨迹监督设计和 THINK 成本—收益评估提供可核查的参照。
